title: Program Learning with Verifiable Rewards: Distilling Expert Traces into Programs
abstract: arXiv:2610.19148v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Small language models struggle with tool-use tasks that require following multi-step procedures. Whether these failures reflect limited capability or missing procedural knowledge remains unclear. We introduce Program Learning with Verifiable Rewards (PLVR), which distils expert traces into reusable programs without updating model weights. Frontier models turn recurring operations in the traces into typed primitives and rules, and search assembles them using reference actions and training-task checks. A small frozen model executes the primitives, with deterministic verifiers checking their outputs. The resulting program guides a student's reasoning or checks its proposed actions. We evaluate the same program across students on $\tau^2$-Bench Retail and Telecom and LiveMCPBench, using synthetic training tasks and unseen benchmark test tasks. translated_title: 可验证奖励的程序学习：将专家轨迹蒸馏为程序
translated_abstract: 小型语言模型在需要遵循多步骤流程的工具使用任务上表现不佳，而这些失败究竟是源于能力有限还是程序性知识缺失，目前尚不清楚。我们提出了可验证奖励的程序学习（PLVR），它无需更新模型权重，即可将专家轨迹蒸馏为可复用的程序。前沿模型将轨迹中反复出现的操作转化为带类型的原语和规则，并通过搜索利用参考动作和训练任务检查将它们组装起来。一个小型冻结模型负责执行这些原语，由确定性验证器检查其输出。由此得到的程序可以引导学生模型的推理，或检查其提出的动作。我们在 τ²-Bench Retail、Telecom 和 LiveMCPBench 上，使用合成训练任务和未见过的基准测试任务，在多个学生模型上评估同一程序。在 Telecom 上，PLVR 将一个 8B 模型的成功率从 43.0% 提升至 91.2%，而规模更大的学生模型……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: PLVR 无需更新模型权重，通过将专家轨迹蒸馏为带确定性验证的可复用程序，让 8B 小模型在 Telecom 工具使用任务上的成功率从 43.0% 跃升至 91.2%。
en_tdlr: PLVR distills expert traces into reusable programs with deterministic verifiers—without updating model weights—raising an 8B model's success rate on Telecom from 43.0% to 91.2%.
